SELECT /* isry.itgcm.bizcmmns.cmmns.DidimTrprInfoMapper.selectDidimTrprInfoList(대상자정보 목록조회) */ CASE WHEN T1.INDV_IDNTFC_NO IS NOT NULL THEN T1.INDV_IDNTFC_NO ELSE T1.TRPR_INFO_NO END AS TRPR_INFO_NO -- 대상자(식별)번호 ,T1.INDV_IDNTFC_NO AS INDV_IDNTFC_NO -- 개인식별번호 ,T2.CASE_MNG_NO AS CASE_MNG_NO -- 사례관리번호(CS) ,(SELECT MAX(CASE_MNG_ODRNO) FROM SEB100 WHERE CASE_MNG_NO=T2.CASE_MNG_NO) AS CASE_MNG_ODRNO -- 사례관리차수 ,T1.UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD AS UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD -- 단위업무구분코드 , CASE WHEN T3.ACBG_SE_CD NOT IN ('01','91','92')THEN (SELECT MAX(T3.ACBG_SE_CD) FROM SEA230 WHERE 1=1 AND T1.TRPR_INFO_NO = T3.TRPR_INFO_NO) ELSE T3.ACBG_SE_CD END AS ACBG_SE_CD -- 학력구분코드 ,(SELECT DISTINCT T3.GRDTN_STTS_SE_CD FROM SEA230 T3 WHERE 1=1 AND T3.ACBG_SE_CD = (SELECT MAX(T3.ACBG_SE_CD) FROM SEA230 T3 WHERE 1=1 AND T1.TRPR_INFO_NO = T3.TRPR_INFO_NO) AND T1.TRPR_INFO_NO = T3.TRPR_INFO_NO) AS GRDTN_STTS_SE_CD -- 졸업상태구분코드 ,C##RG.DEC_B64(T1.TRPR_NM_ENCPT) AS TRPR_NM -- 대상자명암호화 ,T1.TRPR_BRTH_YMD AS TRPR_BRTH_YMD -- 대상자출생일자 ,NULL AS RRNO_ENCPT -- 주민등록번호암호화 ,T1.SXDC_SE_CD AS SXDC_SE_CD -- 성별구분코드 ,C##RG.DEC_B64(T1.MBL_TELNO_ENCPT) AS MBL_TELNO -- 휴대전화번호암호화 ,T1.TRPR_TELNO AS TRPR_TELNO -- 대상자전화번호 ,C##RG.DEC_B64(T1.EML_ADDR_ENCPT) AS EML_ADDR -- 이메일주소암호화 ,T1.SNS_SE_CD AS SNS_SE_CD -- SNS구분코드 ,C##RG.DEC_B64(T1.MSNGR_ID_ENCPT) AS MSNGR_ID -- 메신저아이디암호화 ,T1.ZIP AS ZIP -- 우편번호 ,T1.PST_ADDR AS PST_ADDR -- 우편주소 ,T1.DADDR AS DADDR -- 상세주소 , CASE WHEN T1.ZIP IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE '(' || T1.ZIP || ') ' || T1.PST_ADDR || ' ' || T1.DADDR END AS ADDR -- 주소 , T1.CASE_MNG_SE_CD AS CASE_MNG_SE_CD -- 사례관리구분코드 , T2.CASE_PRGRS_STTS_SE_CD AS CASE_PRGRS_STTS_SE_CD -- 사례진행상태구분코드
, T1.FRST_RGTR_ID AS FRST_RGTR_ID -- 최초등록자아이디 , T1.FRST_REG_DT AS FRST_REG_DT -- 최초등록일시 , T1.LAST_MDFR_ID AS LAST_MDFR_ID -- 최종수정자아이디 , T1.LAST_MDFCN_DT AS LAST_MDFCN_DT -- 최종수정일시 FROM SEA200 T1 ,SEB100 T2 ,SEA230 T3 WHERE 1=1 AND T1.INDV_IDNTFC_NO IS NULL /* TEST 주석처리 */ AND T1.TRPR_INFO_NO = T2.TRPR_INFO_NO(+) AND T1.TRPR_INFO_NO = T3.TRPR_INFO_NO(+) AND T1.FRST_REG_DT BETWEEN TO_DATE(NVL(#{REG_BGNG_YMD}, '00010101') || '000000', 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') -- 등록시작일자 AND TO_DATE(NVL(#{REG_END_YMD}, '99991231') || '235959', 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') -- 등록종료일자
AND T1.TRPR_NM_ENCPT = (C##RG.ENC_B64(#{TRPR_NM})) -- 대상자명
AND T1.MBL_TELNO_ENCPT = (C##RG.ENC_B64(#{MBL_TELNO})) -- 휴대전화번호
AND T1.EML_ADDR_ENCPT = (C##RG.ENC_B64(#{EML_ADDR})) -- 이메일주소
AND T1.TRPR_BRTH_YMD = #{TRPR_BRTH_YMD} -- 대상자출생일자
AND T1.TRPR_TELNO LIKE '%' || #{TRPR_TELNO} || '%' -- 전화번호
AND T1.SNS_SE_CD = #{SNS_SE_CD} -- SNS구분코드
AND T1.MSNGR_ID_ENCPT = (C##RG.ENC_B64(#{MSNGR_ID})) -- 메신저 아이디
AND T1.PST_ADDR LIKE '%' || #{PST_ADDR} || '%' -- 우편주소
/* 발굴등록 최초Load 시 */
AND T1.UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD = #{UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD} -- 단위업무구분(화면 좌측상단체크박스) AND T1.CASE_MNG_SE_CD IN ('01','02','03','04') -- 사례관리구분코드(01:사례대상자미신청, 02:사례대상자신청(대기상태), 03:사례대상자미선정, 04:사례대상자선정)
ORDER BY T1.FRST_REG_DT DESC
